headline: Hong Kong Housing Secretary Winnie Ho Resigns
deck: Hong Kong’s chief executive said Ho stopped performing her duties on Oct. 29 after resigning over the Wang Fuk Court fire.
body: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said Housing Secretary Winnie Ho had resigned to take political responsibility for last year’s Wang Fuk Court fire, though Lee said she had committed no personal wrongdoing. [E1] [E2] [E5]
Lee accepted Ho’s resignation, and she stopped performing the housing secretary’s duties on Oct. 29, RTHK reported. [E4]
Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong will take on the housing portfolio, Dimsum Daily reported. [E2]
The Tai Po estate fire killed 168 people, Dimsum Daily reported. [E3]

evidence_box.fragment: On behalf of the SAR government, I offer my apologies to the victims and the public at large," Lee said in his opening remarks. He added that while Ho committed no personal wrongdoing, she must bear political responsibility as secretary for housing.
